title: lastrea filix-mas subvar. apiciflora
intro: Lastrea filix-mas subvar. apiciflora, commonly known as the Maidenhair Fern, is a type of vascular plant belonging to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lastrea filix-mas subvar. apiciflora are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
